items.title: Benny Golson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We’re having our fiftieth anniversary in March.

ctx.x: Yeah. She’s a dream. When I met her, she was an inspired ballerina, but there wasn’t many opportunities. What black ballerina do you see? She’s not Maria Tallchief or [?] – never make that. So she came over and just devotes all her time to supporting me in what I do. She supports me. She does everything for me except breathe. Sometimes it’s embarrassing. She’s great. We’re having our fiftieth anniversary in March. So I told her. I said, “I think I’ll keep you.” Yeah, she’s great. That’s the difference.
So you stopped driving the truck. Is that when you took up with Bull Moose Jackson?
